races.paceDynamic: Suspicious Mindz is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field. With Oust as the sole prominent runner, there's minimal early pressure expected, allowing Suspicious Mindz to control fractions. The race sets up as a classic front runner's dream with the pace collapsing back to a large pack of hold-up horses including Nil Bua Gan Dua, Tashakour, Chamonix, Coasting, and Fallacy. This tactical scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz gets easy early fractions without pressure from Oust
scenarios.body: Shane Foley can dictate ideal splits and kick clear when the hold-up brigade gets into trouble behind. The uncontested leader holds on as the closers come too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get a perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with Nil Bua Gan Dua's higher class telling late. Tashakour's recent Healy's good form gives him claims too.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Oust tracks closer to Suspicious Mindz and applies earlier pressure
scenarios.body: The early pace quickens enough to set up the race for Oust, who can strike between the tiring leader and the still-gathering hold-up horses. Seamie Heffernan times his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Suspicious Mindz and Oust go very conservatively early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses can win, with Chamonix and Fallacy getting into the mix alongside the principals.

Going reports show consistent yielding conditions across the card - no advantage for specific going preferences

races.paceDynamic: Dial Me In and Star Strewn will dispute the early lead, with both showing confirmed front-running tendencies and likely to go forward from the gates. The pace should be genuine but not frenetic with just two main pace angles, creating a steady rhythm that will test stamina over this mile trip on yielding ground. The hold-up horses like The Publican's Son, Brownstown, and Sursum Corda should get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can benefit from the honest gallop and soft ground conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers' Paradise Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders maintain a steady honest pace without killing each other off
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal positioning to mount late challenges, with the yielding ground suiting their grinding style perfectly. The front two weaken in the final furlong as the closers sweep past.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Dial Me In and Star Strewn go too fast early and tie up dramatically
scenarios.body: The prominent racers inherit a winning position as the leaders fade badly, with the pace collapse happening too quickly for the back markers to capitalize. Mid-division runners find themselves perfectly placed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Dial Me In Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Dial Me In gets an easy lead with Star Strewn failing to go with him early
scenarios.body: The leader dictates terms at his own pace and has enough left to repel late challenges, utilizing his previous course win to maximum advantage. The soft ground plays to his stamina strengths.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses with no pressure on the leaders until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole, suiting a horse with tactical speed who avoided the early positioning battles. An unconsidered runner capitalizes on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee and He's Holding Court are the only confirmed front runners in this 21-runner field, setting up a likely honest gallop from the start. With so many hold-up horses behind them, the early pace should be genuine but not suicidal as the leaders won't face immediate pressure. The large field and one-mile distance will create a strong finish, but the honest early tempo will prevent the race from becoming a pure sprint. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the early pace and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, while the limited early pace will disadvantage pure front runners who rely on soft leads.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee and He's Holding Court maintain a steady gallop without killing each other off early
scenarios.body: The genuine tempo will suit horses that can finish strongly, with the large field creating cover for hold-up performers to unleash late runs. Class horses with proven finishing ability will benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Leaders Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners go too hard early and fade badly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: This creates a perfect scenario for mid-division runners who can inherit the lead and hold-up horses who get the perfect setup for their finishing kicks. The pace collapse will particularly suit horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee finds the right rhythm and maintains a strong tempo all the way to the line
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will find out stamina-shy performers and favour horses with proven staying ability at this distance. Front runners who can sustain their effort and tough stayers will benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go steady early creating a tactical race that becomes a pure sprint from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will turn this into a dash where the best turn of foot wins, favouring horses with natural speed regardless of their usual running style. Fresh horses with raw pace will have the edge.

races.paceDynamic: Big Dispute will lead from the start with no serious early competition, establishing a comfortable rhythm down the back straight. Cut The Rope, Enceladus, Theorist and The Rock Factor will track behind in the prominent positions, while the majority of the field including Eternal Echo, Trojan Fighter and Reynir settle in behind. With just one confirmed front-runner and no early pressure, Big Dispute can dictate at a steady tempo before the inevitable acceleration from the 3f pole. This moderate early pace strongly favours hold-up horses and those that can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Big Dispute sets an uncontested lead but gets swamped in the final 2f as the field closes up behind him. The closers with proven finishing kicks like Eternal Echo and Trojan Fighter can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway and becomes more testing
scenarios.body: The prominent group led by Cut The Rope and Enceladus apply pressure to Big Dispute turning for home, setting up perfectly for those who can race handily. These horses get first run on the leaders while the hold-up brigade are caught too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Big Dispute Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no serious challenges materialise and he stays on strongly
scenarios.body: Big Dispute maintains his advantage throughout despite carrying the early pace, benefiting from the lack of early pressure and his proven stamina at this trip. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late to catch him on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed three-year-olds shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: Almazann, Confused or Strike De Vega produce a debut performance well above their stablemates' recent form, taking advantage of their weight allowance. The Weld, Harrington or Oliver newcomer shows a different level of ability than the exposed older horses.

races.paceDynamic: Limestone will lead from the start with no pace pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. Mr Vettori may track in second, but the prominent runner is unlikely to apply serious pressure given the moderate pace. Port Ferdinand and Summer Is Tomorrow will settle towards the rear, relying on their ability to quicken late. This setup creates a tactical race that heavily favors hold-up horses who can unleash a finishing kick against the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains sedate throughout allowing closers to strike
scenarios.body: Limestone's comfortable lead becomes vulnerable in the straight as Port Ferdinand and Summer Is Tomorrow produce superior late acceleration. The sustainable gallop plays perfectly into the hands of horses with tactical speed who can quicken decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Limestone maintains his rhythm and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells as he finds enough in reserve to repel late challenges, using his early positional advantage effectively. Mr Vettori may chase him home but cannot match the winner's sustained effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Vettori moves early to challenge Limestone and outstays rivals
scenarios.body: Shane Foley times his move perfectly as Mr Vettori attacks the leader approaching the straight and maintains his gallop to the line. The tactical move catches the hold-up horses flat-footed as they struggle to make up the ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes extremely slow leading to a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop sets up a messy cavalry charge where positioning and luck become crucial factors. Summer Is Tomorrow's proven tactical speed gives him the edge in a bunched finish where the best turn of foot prevails.

races.paceDynamic: Apercu is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely to get an uncontested lead with minimal early pressure. Iron Fist, Genealogy, Mano Chicago and Eben Zaabeel will sit prominent but none are aggressive pace-setters, allowing Apercu comfortable fractions. The massive field of hold-up horses including Defiantly, Dar Toungi, and Coeur d'Or creates a wall of traffic concerns in the straight. This sustainable pace followed by a cavalry charge strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Apercu Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Apercu sets modest fractions and holds his kick
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader maintains rhythm while the field comes late in waves, but prominent trackers get first run at him before traffic clears. Iron Fist and Mano Chicago benefit from tactical positioning to strike decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and gaps appear
scenarios.body: The patient brigade gets clear passage and their superior class tells with Defiantly and Dar Toungi timing runs perfectly. Apercu becomes sitting duck for the stronger finishers coming with sustained runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches entering the straight creating interference
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses get hampered while those already handy avoid trouble and capitalize on positional advantage. Genealogy and Apercu profit from being clear of the scramble behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Finds Clear Run
scenarios.trigger: If a bigger-priced hold-up horse gets dream passage through traffic
scenarios.body: One of the lesser-fancied closers like Westminster Moon or Ben Lawers threads the needle while favorites get caught up in trouble. Their fresh conditions and lower weight aids their cause.

races.paceDynamic: Honouramongthieves will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner in this small field of eight. With Delusional the sole prominent runner, the pace will be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing Honouramongthieves to dictate terms without significant early pressure. The majority hold-up horses including Servare, Pliny, and Yousaynothingatall will need the pace to collapse or require strong finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the finishing kick battle that the hold-up brigade will face.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to control fractions and kick clear when challenged, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing ground. Ben Coen can dictate the race from the front without serious early harassment.

scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and one of the closers produces a strong finish
scenarios.body: Servare or Pliny benefit from a crawling pace that sets up perfectly for their finishing kicks, with recent winner Servare particularly dangerous if getting the right race shape. The soft ground aids their stamina-laden profiles over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Delusional tracks the leader closely and outfinishes Honouramongthieves
scenarios.body: Nathan Crosse positions Delusional in the perfect stalking spot behind the leader, then strikes when Honouramongthieves begins to weaken in the final furlong. The prominent style proves ideal for getting first run on the field while avoiding the hold-up horse traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Honouramongthieves and Delusional go too slowly early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the highest-rated hold-up horses like Yousaynothingatall can unleash devastating late kicks. This scenario requires the front two to misjudge the fractions entirely.

watchPoints.text: Honouramongthieves getting an uncontested lead could prove devastating with Ben Coen able to dictate every fraction without harassment.
Servare's finishing fade pattern despite recent win suggests stamina concerns that could surface again over this demanding trip.
The lack of genuine pace-forcing horses beyond Honouramongthieves may create a tactical crawl that negates front-running advantage.
Delusional's prominent style could prove the perfect tactical compromise between leading and trying to close from too far back.
Multiple hold-up horses including Darius Dark and Sea Of Dubka showing fade-in-finish patterns suggests finishing kicks may not materialise.
